material.question: Does a cdylib built for wasm32-wasip2 on the CI toolchain emit a component file the host can Component::from_file?
material.witness_evidence: local rustc 1.99 sysroot doc share/doc/rust/html/rustc/platform-support/wasm32-wasip2.html: 'this target outputs a component'. The produced .wasm is a component; the CI run is the final witness.
